extraFacts.fact: NPT is a tapered pipe thread with a 60° thread angle that is not interchangeable with 55° BSPT; hydraulic NPT joints are normally sealed with PTFE tape or an anaerobic sealant.
extraFacts.source: ASME B1.20.1; Indus Hydraulics NPT adapter listings and guide /blog/stopping-an-npt-thread-leak

extraFacts.fact: A JIC 37° flare end (SAE J514, ISO 8434-2) seals metal-to-metal on a 74° included cone and is not interchangeable with a 45° SAE flare.
An SAE O-ring boss (ORB) port seals on an O-ring compressed in the port; the thread only holds the fitting in place (SAE J1926, ISO 11926).
ISO 6149-1 metric stud ends and ports carry an O-ring seal and a metric thread.
DIN 2353 (ISO 8434-1) is the 24° cone bite-type tube fitting standard; the light (L) and heavy (S) series differ in tube outside diameter and thread.
BSPP (ISO 228-1) is a parallel thread sealed by a bonded seal, O-ring or cone seat rather than on the thread, while BSPT (ISO 7-1, R) is a taper thread that seals on the thread.
JIS B 8363 covers the Japanese 30° cone (60° included) metric and BSP fittings used on Komatsu and other Japanese and Korean machines.
extraFacts.source: JIS B 8363; Indus Hydraulics JIS 30° adapter listings
